== English Reflections II comparison ==
The Players Committee names this complete replacement in its 16 February announcement. The LOST function separately orders hand and Used Pile placement and bases the draw on cards actually placed from hand. This covers empty or blocked hands. USED and the 3 Force cost remain. The named Dark combination is a separate playable family.

[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=932673#p932673 Players Committee errata announcement, 16 February 2015].
